provenance.operatorRationale: The transform decides "produce a document / produce nothing" on array length in five places (SetInformantRegister/index.js:98, RecipientMapper.js:36, ResultMapper.js:16, OffenceMapper.js:37, CourtSessionMapper.js:26). Empty is the boundary each of those sits on, and several of them return `undefined` rather than `[]` — a distinction the outbound JSON preserves by dropping the key. MOST TARGETS ARE SCHEMA_INVALID: only courtApplications, courtApplicationCases, courtApplicationCases[].offences and courtOrderOffences declare minItems 0; every other array in the catalogue declares minItems 1, so emptying it is a contract violation the producer cannot commit. Each variant records which it is.
